# Veinwake — completed selected-Inventor handoff

Status: COMPLETE; construction may begin. Author: Mara Masque. Read against current Make subject 69e89d47fc3406d669e177eb222a94e9ed805d7225b53bb6a6d69c4a96149191. No CAD has been authored by this delegation. No open construction decisions.

Tic-tac-toe — rival mineral growth: tooth crystals and bubble crystals fill a small geode, competing to form its first straight vein.

## Scope and evidence

The accepted Wish fixes this game and theme. All dimensions below are deliberate engineering/design choices implementing the Wish, not measurements of a commercial product. There are no Wish image attachments and no Make lessons in the packet. The source is ordinary two-player 3×3 tic-tac-toe only, not the university document's subsequent larger-board extension.

Sources checked 2026-09-11:
- SDU, DM537 Fall 2013 project, dated November 11, 2013, printed p.3: https://www.imada.sdu.dk/u/petersk/DM537/project1.pdf . The first traditional-game paragraph establishes two players, nine grid spaces, alternating claims of vacant spaces, immediate row/column/diagonal victory, and a filled-board draw. The rest of its n-player assignment is excluded. Text retrieval succeeded; screenshot retrieval failed. No source prose or graphics copied.
- Kata-Log: https://kata-log.rocks/tic-tac-toe-kata . Matching ordinary rules and an explicit sitewide public-domain declaration at the footer. This is the directly verified public-domain expression basis. Its unordered rule checklist omits who starts; the accepted Wish fixes X first. No additional variant imported.
- BGG URL https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/11901/tic-tac-toe was inaccessible in this check. The Wish reports a Public Domain listing; do not claim that listing was independently reverified.
- Current discussion: https://www.reddit.com/r/dataisbeautiful/comments/1vy7yhb/oc_win_rate_by_opening_square_in_15655_online_tic/ . Directly retrieved the post and extensive tactical discussion. Title describes 15,655 online games. Retrieved page labels the post “8d ago,” with comments 6–8 days ago; its crawl metadata is “last week.” This is recent-discussion evidence, not a sales/hotness ranking or a verified statistical dataset. The Wish's absolute date 2026-08-26 was NOT independently verified: do not promote it to a verified publication date or derive an absolute date from cached relative timestamps. JSON endpoint was unavailable. Retain the source game and this bounded trend claim.
- DAR Proyectos, https://dar-proyectos.com/products/tictactoe-stone-game : verified carved soapstone set with contrasting colors. Its craft language, geometry and expression are not design sources.
- OYOY, https://oyoylivingdesign.com/en-en/products/mushroom-tictactoe : verified mushroom pieces and beech construction. Veinwake uses mineral habits rather than fungal forms.
- Title collision found and read: https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/131302/the-seeds-of-cauldron-high-fantasy-character-driven/chapter/3143134/chapter-17-elise-ii-part-1 . “Veinwake” appears as a fictional disease name in The Seeds of Cauldron. No lore or expression is borrowed. Retain the Wish title, but never claim it is globally unique or trademark-cleared.
- Bounded searches: exact title; “geode” “tic tac toe” crystal; “crystal growth” “tic tac toe”; “mineral” “tic tac toe” “geode”. Results included stone sets, unrelated science/craft co-mentions, and the unrelated fiction collision. None inspected established this exact physical pairing. Claim only an unusual original combination; no exhaustive originality claim.

## Frozen equivalence ledger

| Source rule/function | Veinwake meaning and physical cue | Difference |
|---|---|---|
| Exactly 2 players | One owns five tooth crystals (X), the other four bubble crystals (O) | 0 |
| 3×3 grid, nine spaces | Nine circular growth pockets at a straight 36 mm grid | 0 |
| Five X marks and four O marks suffice for any legal game | Five identical tooth solids, four identical bubble solids; one rind | 0 |
| Empty starting board | All nine pockets vacant; both supplies on the table | 0 |
| X starts; alternate turns | Tooth player deposits first, bubble player next | 0 |
| Any vacant cell is legal | Any empty pocket accepts either habit through the same circular seat | 0 |
| One mark per move; no passing | Place one own unused cluster | 0 |
| Claims persist | Placed deposits stay until the game ends | 0 |
| Occupied cells unavailable; no moves/captures/stacking | A deposit excludes the rival; shallow seat holds one cluster | 0 |
| Perfect information | Every space and ownership readable by location and silhouette, without color/text | 0 |
| No randomness | No dice, shuffled components, random start or random effects | 0 |
| Eight possible winning lines | Three rows, three columns, two corner-to-corner diagonals | 0 |
| First line wins immediately | First uninterrupted straight vein of one's habit ends play | 0 |
| Full board with no line draws | Mixed full cavity leaves neither mineral dominant | 0 |
| No score or tiebreaker | Record only tooth win, bubble win or draw | 0 |
| New independent game | Empty the rind; players may exchange roles before starting again | 0 |

Identity map: empty ↔ empty, X ↔ tooth, O ↔ bubble; each source coordinate maps to one fixed pocket. It is bijective and preserves all legal choices, state transitions, terminal checks, winner and draw. Rotation of a marker does not represent state or affect legality. No scoring resource, growth timer, random mineral effect, mechanical joining or extra victory requirement exists. This is a specification audit with zero differences; exhaustive executable replay remains the Manager's deterministic verification, not a physical/human Playtest claim.

## Original complete rules

Give one player the five tooth crystals and the other the four bubble crystals. Begin with every pocket empty. The tooth player goes first. Take turns putting one of your unused crystals into any empty pocket. Once placed, a crystal stays there for the rest of that game: do not move, stack or capture crystals, and do not skip a turn.

You win immediately when your crystals occupy all three pockets of a row, a column or a corner-to-corner diagonal. Stop as soon as a player wins. If the ninth placement fills the board and neither player has a line, the game is a draw. There are no points or tiebreakers. To play again, clear every pocket; you may exchange crystal types before the next game.

## Coordinates, dimensions and interface

Units mm. Board bottom z=0; front is negative y; right is positive x. Pocket centers are x=-36,0,36 crossed with y=-36,0,36. “Back-left”=(-36,36), “back-middle”=(0,36), “back-right”=(36,36); middle-left=(-36,0), center=(0,0).

All nine seats are identical diameter 30 cylinders removed from z=6 to z=8. Each cluster has a diameter 28 circular foot from local z=0 to z=3. Clearance is explicitly 1 mm RADIAL per side (30−28)/2. Seat floor is z=6, field top z=8: exact seat depth 2. Seated clusters occupy global z=6…32. Every cluster is exactly 28 mm maximum width and 26 mm tall. A 6 mm floor remains under the seats; nearest pocket walls are 6 mm apart (36−30). Minimum designed rind material thickness is 3 mm; the specified profile leaves greater structural margins. No interference retention, hardware or lid.

Rind outer dimensions 140×130, flat bottom. A low peripheral rock ridge reaches z=10 while the central field is z=8. The full seated set envelope is exactly 140×130×32. The held demonstration deliberately exceeds the normal assembled height; it is a different action state.

## Construction-ready original geometry

Rind: build a solid rounded irregular rock plate with these counterclockwise XY perimeter vertices, in sequence:
(-70,-25), (-60,-48), (-38,-65), (28,-65), (54,-52), (70,-22), (70,20), (57,48), (34,65), (-30,65), (-55,50), (-70,24).
Round each 2D polygon corner with radius 6 mm. Straight extrema segments preserve exactly x=±70 and y=±65. Extrude z=0…10. Cut a centered rounded rectangle 114×104 with 22 mm corner radius downward from z=10 to z=8, giving a broad uneven-width raised rock rind around the field. Cut the nine diameter 30 seats to z=6. The irregular rock perimeter and shallow cavity must read as a split stone rather than a square game tray. All outer faces vertical or inward bevels; no bottom-edge fillet that produces unsupported outward rounding. No decorative cracks crossing or visually bending the 3×3 coordinates. No thin raised text. Exact model may use tangent arcs in the footprint to produce the specified 6 mm corner rounding.

Tooth cluster (five identical parts): one diameter 28, height 3 flat-foot disc. Union a six-sided faceted crystal with circumradius 11 mm centered at (0,0), starting local z=2 and extending vertically to z=18. Use vertex angles 0,60,120,180,240,300 degrees. From that hexagon at z=18, ruled loft inward to a same-orientation circumradius 2.5 mm hexagon centered at (2,0) at z=26. The top is flat: minimum flat-to-flat tip span 4.330 mm, comfortably exceeding the 2 mm blunt-tip requirement. One tall dominant tooth per marker means exactly three dominant exposed peaks read across a winning row. The broad hexagonal shoulders make it a mineral habit rather than an X, pawn or character head. No spurs or secondary sharp peaks. All footprints above the foot stay within the diameter 28 footprint, so no support overhang is introduced. Upward taper is entirely inward despite its 2 mm tip offset.

Bubble cluster (four identical parts): same diameter 28, height 3 foot. Union three vertical lobes whose XY centers are (-5.196152423,-3), (5.196152423,-3), (0,6), each radius 7. From local z=2 to z=19 use straight cylindrical lobe walls; crown each with only its UPPER hemisphere radius 7 centered at z=19, making total z=26. Do not use full spheres perched on narrow stems. The three cylinders overlap one another and the solid foot; the footprint lies within the diameter 28 foot (center radius6+lobe radius7, leaving 1 mm foot margin). Their three rounded crowns and tactile scalloped silhouette contrast with the tooth's planar facets. Upper hemispheres contract upward and need no supports; no descending sphere underside or thin neck exists. Smooth crowns retain 7 mm curvature radius. All three crowns are the same height; do not add extra bubbles.

Construction stance: each part prints upright on its flat foot/bottom at local z=0. Ten detached printed solids, no support material, hardware, glue, snap fits or electrical load. Print gate checks must verify this design before any print-ready claim. Geometry measurements establish theoretical fit only.

Palette is supplementary: rind warm dark stone #796D60; teeth muted amethyst #9C78BE; bubbles pale jade #94C5B4. Use direct sRGB channels in STEP. Monochrome form must remain sufficient; colors never encode additional state.

## Exact state composition and source trace

Five-turn signature trace, source coordinates (row from back, column from left):
1. X (0,0) ↔ tooth_1 at (-36,36,6).
2. O (1,0) ↔ bubble_1 at (-36,0,6).
3. X (0,1) ↔ tooth_2 at (0,36,6).
4. O (1,1) ↔ bubble_2 at (0,0,6).
5. X (0,2) ↔ tooth_3 at (36,36,6), terminal X win/back-row vein.

Before panel is the legal board after turn 4 plus tooth_3 held directly above its destination at (36,36,61), i.e. +55 mm from its seated transform. After panel lowers only tooth_3 by 55 mm. Its tip moves from z=87 to z=32. The held piece has not yet changed the game state. No hand, rod or support becomes an eleventh printed part. Use identical elevated front camera, target and scale in both panels, looking toward +y with all back-row peaks visible. Five active pieces are shown; unused supply is outside the focused signature frame. Do not depict all unused pieces occupying extra pockets.

Main combined delivery assembly includes ALL TEN parts within 140×130×32. It shows the following legitimate full-board draw, with row order back/middle/front:
X O X
X O O
O X X
Assign tooth_1 back-left, tooth_2 back-right, tooth_3 middle-left, tooth_4 front-middle, tooth_5 front-right; bubble_1 back-middle, bubble_2 center, bubble_3 middle-right, bubble_4 front-left. A legal no-earlier-win placement order is back-left X, back-middle O, back-right X, center O, middle-left X, middle-right O, front-middle X, front-left O, front-right X. Final outcome draw. Each part appears once, with foot z=6. This inventory rendering is distinct from the five-move signature illustration.

## Required checks and bounded claims

Manager must check ten single-solid outputs, all 28×26 clusters, 140×130×32 normal assembly, 36 mm grid, 30 mm seats, 28 mm feet, 2 mm seat depth, ≥3 mm rind walls, and tooth cap ≥2 mm. Check every seat accepts each habit without rotational keying; active pieces remain stationary across signature except tooth_3's exact −55 mm translation. Compare matched game traces and terminal checks; no mechanical animation can replace this rules check.

Inspect elevated front and overhead views for geode read, nine straight pockets, tooth/bubble distinction, exposed peaks and no intersections. Source-free blind review and deterministic print gates remain Manager responsibilities. No physical print, tactile handling, durability, customer response or playtest has been performed. These are verification limits, not unresolved design choices.


SUPERSEDING COMPLETED RIND REPAIR (original handoff above retained as history):
# Veinwake rind repair — completed handoff

Status: COMPLETE. This is the selected-Inventor design dependency for one focused root CAD repair. Only the rind geometry changes. No CAD was authored here.

## Observed issue

Inspected current veinwake_lib.py and canonical signature.png once. The body's broad straight polygon edges, flat level annulus and regular rounded-rectangle cavity read as a manufactured game tray. Teeth, bubbles and winning placement are readable. Root reports depth-buffer repair has removed the render slivers; this design revision addresses the remaining physical-form defect.

## Decision

Accept rim maximum z=14 (previously10), while keeping field z=8, all seat floors z=6, seat depth2, diameter30, grid36 and all cluster geometry unchanged. The top of every seated cluster stays32, leaving18 mm above the highest rind. Replace the twelve-sided plate footprint and regular cavity with a smooth asymmetric pebble silhouette and an irregular geological terrace. Do not merely raise the existing octagonal tray.

## Exact construction

1. Make a closed, smooth outer XY footprint from a superellipse exponent3.5, semiaxes70 and65. At angle theta, use:
   x=70*sign(cos(theta))*abs(cos(theta))**(2/3.5)
   y=65*sign(sin(theta))*abs(sin(theta))**(2/3.5)
   multiply x and y by
   q=1-0.012*sin(2*theta)**2*(1+0.25*sin(3*theta)).
   This adds a slight coherent asymmetry while retaining the four exact extrema. Interpolate a periodic closed spline through64 evenly spaced samples; do not leave a visible64-sided polygon. Normalize the finished XY wire to exact140×130 using its actual bounding box, centered at(0,0), so spline overshoot cannot change the required envelope. This contour is a broad rounded pebble, not an octagon and not an ellipse that clips corner pockets.
2. Extrude this footprint fromz0 toz14. Keep the entire bottom planar atz0. Round only the OUTER TOP perimeter edges with radius4. Do this before the cavity/seat cuts so the selector cannot accidentally fillet pocket edges. No lower exterior rounding or outward lower overhang.
3. Form a lower cavity XY face by taking the outer footprint's inward parallel offset13 mm and UNIONING nine radius16.5 mm circles at the exact grid centers. The circles ensure each pocket and each diameter28 marker has a generous open passage even where the offset pebble contour approaches a corner. Fuse the face into one connected opening. This boundary is determined by the rock and growth-site clearances rather than a standard rounded rectangle.
4. Cut that lower cavity face fromz8 throughz15. Form the upper cavity opening by an outward parallel offset2.5 mm of the lower opening; cut this larger face fromz11 throughz15. Result: a broad irregular geological rim atz14; an intermediate continuous mineral terrace atz11; the field atz8. The terrace's2.5 mm width is a supported horizontal ledge on the thick body, not a freestanding2.5 mm wall. The upper opening grows upward, so there is no unsupported ceiling or undercut.
5. Cut the original nine diameter30 seats fromz6 upward through the field. Seat bottoms and rims remain horizontal. Do not move a center, deepen a seat, key the pocket to one mineral habit or add geometry that modifies placement legality.
6. Retain a single fused rind solid, existing surface color and all nine markers. Do not add separate crystal gravel, a second shell, loose decorations or extra printed parts. The full set remains ten solids,140×130×32 seated.

## Clearance and robustness decisions

The13 mm inward offset normally gives an11−0.5 mm top annulus after widening the upper opening; the exterior4 mm round leaves6.5 mm nominal plan material in those regions. Where radius16.5 keepout circles determine the cavity, the outer exponent3.5 contour was selected specifically to keep the diagonal corners fuller than an ellipse. The upper circle extent is radius19 mm (16.5+2.5), and it must retain at least3 mm actual material to the rounded outer skin. Check the exact CAD minimum before sealing; this is a deterministic construction exit criterion, not permission to narrow the wall.

If the spline kernel introduces any localized distance less than3 mm, resolve it deterministically by intersecting the upper opening with the outer footprint offset inward7 mm BEFORE cutting. Seven accounts for the4 mm top rounding plus the3 mm required wall. Preserve the complete lower radius16.5 keepout openings when applying that top limit; the chosen contour is intended to admit them. Do not change seats or ask the operator to choose a wall. Prefer exact wires/offsets over many decorative booleans.

A top-edge fillet is geometrically support-free because the body contracts upward. Lower rounded edges remain forbidden. Every sharp perimeter junction from cavity unions is a shallow vertical surface; no fillet is needed on the cavity, and adding one risks shrinking the marker passage.

## Intended visible result and verification

The rounded exterior sidewall should shade continuously like a stone. The two unequal cavity bands should read as a split geode's rind and mineral lining. Their widths vary around the perimeter. Nine circular pockets still read as three straight rows; do not scallop or curve the grid itself. Tooth tips and all bubble crowns remain exposed above the low body.

Use the same fixed elevated front camera and framing for before/after. Regenerate both exact-state STEPs and images; the one moving tooth still translates exactly55 mm. Retain the normal full-draw inventory assembly. Verify pocket depth/grid, ten single solids, bounding box, minimum walls, overhang and thickness; then obtain a fresh independent rereview. This handoff makes no claim that a subsequent render or physical print already passes.
